full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos. 7 and 12 contested the suit by filing separate written statements. They categorically denied the plaintiff's title and possession of the suit land. Besides taking various pleas of limitation, etc. defendant No.12 alleged that 8 annas interest of aforesaid Kalipada Biswas was purchased by Monoranjan in the benami of one Ajhar in Money Execution Case No. 1312 of 1928, who got delivery of possession through Court and started possessing the same. Ajhar executed a registered Nadabipatra dated 19.9.1929 in favour of the said Monoranjan who while in possession sold the land to Shubashini and Madhab on 13.10.1930. Hemant sold remaining 8 annas share to Madhab who died leaving only son Monoranjan Banerjee who got the entire suit plot by amicable partition. He died leaving sons’ defendants’ No. 2-5 who sold the suit land to defendant No.12 on 27.3.1974. He (defendant No. 12) claimed possession in the suit land denying the case of both the plaintiff and defendant No. 7
